headers.Idempotency-Key: Required: one UUID per logical action; preserve it on retries

http.instructions: Send JSON {tool, arguments}. HTTP retry identity belongs in the Idempotency-Key header, never arguments.idempotency_key; MCP uses idempotency_key inside its tool arguments.

arguments_schema.description: Bring Bridgit or a discovered target forward using app.foreground authority; applet/portal targets also need applet_portals. Minimum 1 second between switches, maximum 12 per minute per device. Result foreground confirms the requested target is visible; otherwise a notification fallback may need an owner tap. Does not unlock or grant OS consent.
